operations.title: Connections within a number of steps
operations.description: Minimum hop distances with explicit independent or nearest-source searches. Preserve direction; discard loops and collapse duplicate arcs; weights are ignored. IDs are signed int64 or strings.

operations.title: Count or list triangles
operations.description: Count three-vertex cliques of an undirected graph. Discard loops and collapse duplicate edges; weights are ignored. GPU enumeration uses native CPU materialization with count verification.

operations.title: Shortest weighted paths from one vertex
operations.description: Nonnegative lengths; preserve direction, drop loops and keep minimum parallel length. CPU returns exact rational costs over admitted binary64 weights; GPU returns float64 costs. Cutoff is inclusive.
gpu_limitations: Path cost bounds must fit float64; integral costs beyond 2^53 require CPU

operations.title: Shortest paths between selected vertex sets
operations.description: Selected origins and destinations, or all vertices for null. Nonnegative lengths, minimum parallel length and preserved direction; CPU exact costs and GPU float64 costs.
gpu_limitations: Path cost bounds must fit float64; integral costs beyond 2^53 require CPU

operations.title: Minimum or maximum spanning forest
operations.description: Undirected weighted forests with isolates retained. Negative lengths are allowed. Keep minimum or maximum parallel weights according to the objective; discard loops.

operations.title: Connected vertex groups
operations.description: Weak or strong connectivity. Weak mode uses an undirected projection; strong mode preserves direction. Loops, duplicate edges and weights do not affect membership.

operations.title: Order a directed acyclic graph
operations.description: Return a deterministic topological order. Reject directed cycles, including self-loops. Duplicate arcs collapse; weights are ignored.

operations.title: PageRank influence scores
operations.description: Directed random-walk scores with uniform restart and dangling distribution. Drop loops, sum parallel weights and independently verify the fixed-point residual.

operations.title: Rank vertices by their number of connections
operations.description: Exact degree scores with outgoing, incoming, both or undirected-projection semantics. Drop loops, collapse duplicate edges and ignore weights. Optional normalization divides by n-1; isolates score zero.

operations.title: Rank vertices that connect shortest paths
operations.description: All-source betweenness excluding endpoints. Preserve direction, drop loops and keep minimum parallel length. CPU supports exact rational scores and strictly positive weighted paths; GPU profiles use unweighted paths with declared floating-point arithmetic.

backends.execution: original all-source GPU Brandes kernels, float32 accumulation

gpu_limitations: Original turbo-bc supports undirected graphs and uses float32 accumulation; libcugraph supports either direction
Shortest-path counts must fit signed int32; larger inputs receive bounded CPU admission checks

operations.title: Restart walks around seed vertices
operations.description: Seeded PageRank with explicit direction, weight and dangling policies. Full score port stays complete when the displayed ranking is filtered or capped.
gpu_limitations: Custom uniform dangling redistribution uses the CPU profile

operations.title: Score potential links from local neighborhoods
operations.description: Undirected simple neighborhoods; loops and weights ignored. CPU supports eight local measures; GPU supports Jaccard. Candidate limits apply before top_k; capped output is explicitly incomplete.

operations.title: Find capacity and bottlenecks between two places
operations.description: Exact rational flow and cut certificate. Sum parallel capacities, discard loops and treat undirected edges as two directed arcs. Optional vertex capacities use typed {vertex,capacity} records and include explicitly limited terminals. Mixed cuts return original edge IDs plus cut vertices.

backends.execution: isolated original CUDA flow worker with native exact flow and cut certification

gpu_limitations: ecl-maxflow: nonnegative integral normalized capacities with total <=1e9; no vertex capacities
At most 1M vertices and 10M input edges; exact residual flow/cut certification

operations.title: Find the highest-value non-conflicting pairs
operations.description: Exact maximum-weight matching on an undirected graph, with no cardinality constraint. Require nonnegative weights; discard loops and keep the largest parallel weight. Preserve selected original edge IDs and return exact rational totals over admitted binary64 weights. Zero-weight edges may be omitted.

operations.title: Match items on two sides by count, value or cost
operations.description: Exact cardinality, weight or cost matching with attributes.side=left|right on every vertex. Reject same-side edges and loops; keep the best parallel edge. Weighted objectives require explicit weights. Without required smaller-side coverage, empty matching may be optimal. Infeasible coverage has no witness port.

backends.execution: isolated original CUDA assignment worker with native exact optimality verification

gpu_limitations: hungarian-cuda: minimum-cost perfect assignment, complete equal sides, at most 64 per side
Every input cost must be an integer in [0,999]; native C++ verifies the optimum

operations.title: Find complete groups that cannot be extended
operations.description: Exact maximal cliques in an undirected simple projection. Drop loops and duplicate edges; ignore weights. Original GPU kernels supply a count, with bounded C++ materialization and explicit list completeness.

backends.execution: original GPU count plus bounded native materialization

gpu_limitations: GPU count plus bounded native materialization
A forward-subset count bound must fit uint64

operations.title: Find the largest fully connected group
operations.description: Exact maximum clique, optionally all tied optima. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Original GPU witnesses are checked by native coloring or exact search; ties use native materialization.

backends.execution: original GPU witness plus native optimality proof

operations.title: Count or list complete groups of a chosen size
operations.description: Exact count for k>=2 with no upper k bound on CPU. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. GPU counts require supported k and a uint64 count bound. Counts remain complete when memberships are capped.

backends.execution: original GPU count plus optional bounded native materialization

gpu_limitations: graphset: k=3..6; gamma: k=3..7; kcgpu: k=3..10; k larger than vertex count returns zero
A forward-subset count bound must fit uint64

operations.title: Find fragile connections and cut vertices
operations.description: Exact vertex-biconnected edge blocks, bridges and articulation vertices. Undirected input; loops discarded and parallel edges collapsed. Every normalized edge keeps its first original ID and all source edge IDs.

operations.title: Find connections supported by triangles
operations.description: Complete edge truss numbers using the k-2 support convention, plus optional k-truss selection. Undirected simple projection, weights ignored. First original edge IDs represent collapsed edges; source IDs are retained.

operations.title: Find the well-connected core
operations.description: Exact core numbers and optional selected vertices. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Isolates have core number zero.

operations.title: Find the largest non-conflicting group
operations.description: Exact maximum independent set via maximum clique of the complement. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Complement construction and search are bounded.

backends.execution: original GPU witness plus native optimality proof

operations.title: Cover every connection with as few vertices as possible
operations.description: Exact minimum vertex cover, or decision against k, from a maximum independent set. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Native complement construction and search are bounded.
